title: omux redacted route-state v0.2 (TIN-1803)
description: No-spend, token-free route readiness envelope shared by status, statusline, and doctor. Declaration-only: no reducer projects this yet (see docs/spec/2026-08-28-redacted-route-state-truth-design.md). Forbids raw account ids, emails, tokens, and request bodies -- only opaque handles.

route_handle.description: Opaque handle, never a raw account id/email. Matches the managed-harness-v2 handle idiom.

freshness_deadline_ms.description: Epoch ms after which this record must be re-probed rather than trusted as-is.

trusted_reset_at_ms.description: Present only for rate_limited/quota_exhausted -- when the provider-declared window is expected to clear.

provenance.description: never_probed is the only provenance value legal for state=unknown; every other state requires one of health.zig's existing ProbeEvidenceSource values.

action_class.description: Coarse next-step class only -- never a raw remediation URL, token, or request body.
